It's probably been 3 weeks since I last posted. I’ve been kinda busy, but I’ve procrastinated a fair share and made ill decisions with my time. Hopefully that can change, and I can get back to writing to my vacant audience. That said, I’ve created a decent digital archive over the past 3-4 months. This will be my 15th post. I planned to post a little commentary about riding the bus a few weeks ago, but I didn’t like it and never finished it. So it goes.

Thoughts (from my notes over the past few weeks)

Don’t go walking at night. I’ve had a few too many skunk encounters. These skunks are big and buff. I saw one that looked like Rigby that one time he became a skunk werewolf thing in that one episode.

I love and hate those Coke machines with every drink under the sun. They’re good cause they have all those drinks, but you touch an icon, and it takes a good 5 seconds to register. Maybe I should just stop complaining and count my blessings.

2018 must have been a good year for black people. Green Book won Best Picture, while Blackkklansmen and black panther were nominated.

Where is everyone getting these 12-ft-tall skeletons?

Prettyboyjj.

“Momma ain’t raise no sissy punk”

What’s a theme park without long lines? Is it really a theme park?

How is something on the tip of your tongue? Say two humans are mating and the male sperm isn’t coming out. Is sperm on the tip of his dick? I think not. So how can a word be on the tip of your tongue? Maybe the word’s on the tip of your amygdala or some brain part.

Costco lost my love after they took away the footlong churro

Grocery stores used to be fun to go to. They still are to an extent, but it’s not the same. Especially Trader Joe’s; that shit was magical. This could just be my nostalgia talking.

Can we please put a hat on Mike Tomlin? It’s like seeing King Neptune in SpongeBob without his crown

Link kinda moves like Toothless, except he’s white. So maybe he’s like Toothless’s wife, but then that wouldn’t make sense cause link’s a male.

I went to an Alabama state park in Huntsville a week ago. Maybe I read it wrong, but I thought the sign said 1.2 miles. Instead, I walked 2.1 miles in church clothes and Sperrys, and it took an hour and thirty minutes.
